guides.title: How big should your neon sign be?
guides.excerpt: Measure once, glow forever. How letter height, word count and the furniture underneath decide the right size, with a to-scale room you can try it in.

guides.title: How LED neon is made
guides.excerpt: From a drawing to a lit sign in five steps: drawn, bent, mounted, tested and boxed. What happens to your words in a UK workshop.

guides.title: LED neon vs glass neon: what you're actually buying
guides.excerpt: Glass neon is a beautiful old craft; LED neon is lighter, cooler and far easier to live with. An honest look at where each one wins, and why we make LED.

guides.title: How to hang a neon sign
guides.excerpt: Screws and standoffs, hanging chains, adhesive strips or a table stand: which method suits your wall, and how to do each one without drama.

guides.title: Looking after your sign
guides.excerpt: A soft cloth, the right spot and a dimmer used kindly. How to keep your sign glowing, plus what it really costs to run.

guides.title: My sign won't light: a calm checklist
guides.excerpt: Before you panic: socket, plug, dimmer, remote. A step-by-step check of the connection chain, and what to send us if it's still dark.

guides.title: Choosing colours: white jacket or coloured?
guides.excerpt: Why a hot-pink sign can look white by day, when a coloured jacket is worth it, and how colour-changing tubes compare. Try it with your own words.

guides.title: Backing types: cut to shape, rectangle or stand
guides.excerpt: The acrylic behind the tube changes how a sign sits on the wall. Cut to shape, rectangle or table stand, and which finish to pick.

guides.title: Wedding neon: sizes, words and timing
guides.excerpt: What to write, how big to go for a top table or backdrop, and when to order so it arrives with a week to spare. Then where it lives after the day.

guides.title: Neon signs for business: logos, shopfronts and bars
guides.excerpt: Logo signs, open signs and counter signs: what reads from the street, what works behind a bar, and how a free mockup turns your artwork into tube.
